object.claim_boundary: The artifact is a public-safe read-only demonstration candidate. It does not constitute a public deployment, live safety directive, survey, inspection, work order, completed remediation, assistance decision, adverse score, or canonical task-count transition.

views.object: Public place identity, rounded coordinates, public geometry, imagery, terrain, and source coverage
views.safe_action: Inspect source coverage and request an authorized capture or source review when street evidence is unavailable.
views.authority: Read-only public context; no parcel, survey, visibility, access, ownership, or completed-inspection authority.
views.prohibited_consequence: No property valuation, insurance, enforcement, access, work, or safety determination.

views.object: National Weather Service point, forecast, hourly, station, observation, and alert state
views.safe_action: Read the source time and active alert text, then follow the named official authority for any time-critical direction.
views.authority: Public weather context only; no guarantee of current local conditions at the demonstration point.
views.prohibited_consequence: No evacuation, closure, work, medical, or safety decision based only on this projection.

views.object: USGS nearby monitoring-site availability and returned instantaneous values
views.safe_action: Open the named USGS monitoring source and verify site, parameter, qualifier, and time before using the value.
views.authority: Monitoring-location context only; no household, irrigation, plant, potable-water, drainage, or site-condition authority.
views.prohibited_consequence: No watering instruction, infrastructure decision, contamination claim, or household water inference.

views.object: CAL FIRE/NIFC/FIRIS perimeter and NASA FIRMS acquisition state
views.safe_action: Read incident identity, source time, geometry scope, and official alert channels; route verified mitigation needs toward assistance rather than adverse scoring.
views.authority: Public incident and thermal-detection context only; no parcel threat, evacuation, containment, damage, cause, or insurance authority.
views.prohibited_consequence: No insurance coverage denial, premium setting, evacuation order, enforcement, property-risk score, or loss determination.

actors.evidence: Public place identity, source status, source times, public summaries, and visible claim boundaries.
actors.safe_action: Read, compare, open the source receipt, and follow the named official authority where applicable.
actors.authority: May use the artifact as public context only.
actors.acceptance: The visitor can identify what is known, unknown, stale, unavailable, and prohibited without a manual.
actors.handoff: Route a source problem or accessibility defect to the program operator with the retained receipt.

actors.evidence: Public context, source health, authored registration marks, field-verification requirements, and unresolved gaps.
actors.safe_action: Prepare a bounded verification plan and preserve site, equipment, safety, consent, and acceptance requirements before any work proposal.
actors.authority: May plan within granted site authority; may not infer inspection, entry, work, completion, or resident consent from public context.
actors.acceptance: Every proposed site action names the evidence still required, accountable actor, safety boundary, and completion receipt.
actors.handoff: Return a bounded offer or hold to the accountable site actor and route cross-jurisdiction issues to the program operator.

actors.evidence: Provider health, public context, source gaps, assistance channels, field holds, and accountable decision authority.
actors.safe_action: Route verified needs to assistance, source repair, or accountable human review without producing one punitive place score.
actors.authority: May coordinate only within lawful program authority; may not make insurance, eligibility, enforcement, property, or resident decisions from this dossier.
actors.acceptance: Actor, source, offer, decision, authority, execution, refusal, appeal, and follow-through remain traceable.
actors.handoff: Return a public-safe offer, explicit hold, or source-repair request with the controlling receipt and next-review condition.

source_states.meaning: The registered request returned an admitted payload and receipt.
source_states.display_law: Show source time, retrieval time, transform, rights, health, and claim scope.

source_states.meaning: The provider responded successfully but returned no qualifying item or coverage.
source_states.display_law: Show honest empty coverage and never translate it into safe, zero, or no condition.

source_states.meaning: The retained evidence exceeds its admitted maximum age or valid-through condition.
source_states.display_law: Keep the last evidence visible with a stale label, time, consequence, and refresh path.

source_states.meaning: The outbound request was not attempted because no approved credential was configured.
source_states.display_law: Name the missing provider operation and prohibit fixture or modeled substitution.

source_states.meaning: The provider refused or delayed the request under a quota or rate limit.
source_states.display_law: Show retry and cache rules without presenting prior evidence as current.

source_states.meaning: The provider, network, transform, or required artifact was unavailable.
source_states.display_law: Show what remains known, what is unknown, safe fallback, and accountable next action.

source_states.meaning: Rights, storage, redistribution, or provider terms prohibit inclusion in the public artifact.
source_states.display_law: Retain metadata and claim boundary without copying prohibited payload bytes.

source_states.meaning: The acquisition state cannot be classified from the retained receipt.
source_states.display_law: Hold the source and prohibit positive claims until an accountable review resolves it.

allowed_fields: public imagery permitted by source terms
prohibited_fields: insurance, enforcement, eligibility, property, or resident score

required_campaigns: distinct actor evidence, action, authority, acceptance, and handoff
zero external requests from the built artifact
zero console, page, and failed-request errors

prohibited_uses: insurance denial, underwriting, premium setting, or coverage triage
property valuation, resident scoring, eligibility ranking, or enforcement
evacuation, closure, inspection, work order, dispatch, or completed-work determination
medical, safety, contamination, irrigation, or household condition decision
presentation of statewide, regional, nearby, authored, missing, or stale evidence as a verified local condition
adverse_action_boundary.required_human_control: Any external action requires a separate lawful authority, named accountable human decision, source-specific evidence, affected-actor notice where applicable, acceptance and appeal paths, and an independently reviewable receipt.

admission_law: The candidate is admissible only on an exact head that synchronizes the admitted source foundation and Forkline constitution, passes live acquisition and validation, emits a privacy-safe projection, passes static and browser campaigns, retains full-state captures and receipts, receives contained board admission with no open critical or high veto, and preserves no public or constitutional-count effect.
control_question: Can a public visitor, steward, program operator, and cold successor each use the same source-backed place dossier while preserving source scope, failure, privacy, authority, and prohibited consequence without receiving a private record or a false local determination?
